**Depends on:** None.

TUTORIAL.md scaffold tree and file count out of date (22 vs 26 actual files)

**Description:** `sun new workspace` generates 26 files and the CLI prints "Done. 26 files generated." TUTORIAL.md line 133 states "This generates 22 files." and the tree listing omits four generated files: `.dockerignore`, `db/migrations/0001_notifications.down.sql`, `test/test_schemas.ml`, and `test/dune`. The generated workspace `README.md` template (`tpl_readme` in `sun_cli_cmd_new.ml`) also omits all four from its Project layout section.

**Impact:** An engineer reading the tutorial and seeing "Done. 26 files generated." experiences trust erosion when the guide says 22. The `test/` directory — which contains the schema compatibility CI gate documented later in Part 7 — appears unexplained at scaffold time and could be deleted or ignored. The companion down-migration file (for `sun migrate rollback`) is invisible from the workspace README.

**Remediation:**
1. Update TUTORIAL.md line 133 from "This generates 22 files" to "This generates 26 files".
2. Add the four missing entries to the TUTORIAL tree listing with brief inline descriptions:
   - `.dockerignore` — excludes `_build/` and `.git/` from Docker build context
   - `db/migrations/0001_notifications.down.sql` — companion rollback migration (used by `sun migrate rollback`)
   - `test/test_schemas.ml` — schema backward-compatibility CI gate (run with `SCHEMA_REGISTRY_URL=... dune test test/`)
   - `test/dune` — build file for the schema test
3. Update `tpl_readme` in `cli/sun/lib/sun_cli_cmd_new.ml` to add `test/`, `db/migrations/*.down.sql`, and `.dockerignore` to the Project layout section so the workspace-level README is self-consistent.
